title: PullQuoteContent
description: Pull quote content: the words, the author, a role line and the source as a link. One object is valid in every pull quote layout (a rule at the side, centred).

title.description: the name of the author (names the section)

description.description: the role of the author; empty: none

sourceLabel.description: the label of the source; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set
